rv.q: This path is no trail of bread crumbs. It is Mr. Sondheim's score...that keeps leading you onward in a show that does not inspire confidence on all levels.
This is a flashier and blessedly brisker presentation of Sondheim and Lapine's crazy quilt of fairy tales for our unhappy-ever-after age.

Best Featured Actress in a Musical

aw.sub: Won Best Revival of a Musical + 1 more

cn.t: This revival of Sondheim and Lapine's beloved musical enchants with its enduring score leading the way through the fairy-tale forest, while inventive touches like a scene-stealing live cow bring fresh energy to the production.

vs.sum: One of Broadway's least comfortable theaters, with notoriously tight legroom and narrow seats. The lack of rake means tall patrons in front block your view. Restrooms are in the basement, creating long intermission lines. For legroom, target Row A or N in Orchestra.

acc.note: 6 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. No steps from sidewalk. Infrared devices available.
